description: This file contains unit tests for TLS (Transport Layer Security) support in Orleans connections, including certificate creation, configuration of TLS for clients and silos, and end-to-end testing of encrypted communication using Orleans testing infrastructure. It defines test classes, configuration helpers, and a simple grain interface and implementation for verifying data transmission over TLS.

classes.name: TlsConnectionTests
classes.description: Contains tests for TLS support in Orleans, including certificate creation, configuration, and end-to-end encrypted communication tests.

classes.name: TlsClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures TLS settings for Orleans clients in tests, including certificate setup and SSL protocols.

classes.name: TlsServerConfigurator
classes.description: Configures TLS settings for Orleans silos in tests, including server certificates and SSL protocols.

classes.name: IPingGrain
classes.description: A simple grain interface with an Echo method used to verify data transmission over TLS.

classes.name: PingGrain
classes.description: A grain implementation that echoes back input strings, used for testing TLS data integrity.

methods.name: CanCreateCertificates
methods.description: Tests creation, encoding, and decoding of self-signed certificates.

methods.name: TlsEndToEnd
methods.description: Performs end-to-end TLS communication tests with various certificate configurations and modes.
